observation.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf .build-logs/stage-mfew && mkdir -p .build-logs/stage-mfew && cp 01-frontend/Dockerfile .build-logs/stage-mfew/ 2>/dev/null
# Create a corrected mfe-ws Dockerfile based on mfe-fp's proven pattern (build shared first)
sed -e 's/--workspace mfe-ws --include-workspace-root=false/--workspace mfe-ws --workspace shared --include-workspace-root=false/' \
    -e 's|RUN npm run -w mfe-ws build|RUN npm run -w shared build\n\nRUN npm run -w mfe-ws build|' \
    01-frontend/mfe-ws/Dockerfile > /tmp/mfew-dockerfile
# stage the whole 01-frontend
rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude node_modules --exclude '**/dist' --exclude '**/dist-injector' --exclude .vite --exclude .cache 01-frontend/ /tmp/mfew-ctx/
cp /tmp/mfew-dockerfile /tmp/mfew-ctx/mfe-ws-fixed.Dockerfile
diff <(sed -n '12,28p' 01-frontend/mfe-ws/Dockerfile) <(sed -n '12,32p' /tmp/mfew-ctx/mfe-ws-fixed.Dockerfile)
